questions.question: What did Solomon do before the altar in front of the assembly?
options: Read aloud the law of Moses
Spread out his hands and prayed
questions.answer: Spread out his hands and prayed

questions.question: In his prayer, Solomon acknowledged that even what could not contain God?
options: The seas and all their depths
The temple he had just built
The whole earth and its fullness

questions.question: Solomon prayed that God would hear and forgive when his people pray toward this house.
Solomon knelt on a bronze _____ he had made and prayed.
Solomon asked that when foreigners pray toward the house, God would hear from _____.
